rationale: The last 5 one-minute candles show a consistent downward drift from $16.50 to $16.41, with price trading below the 9-EMA ($16.48) and volume accelerating on the sell side — suggesting short-term selling pressure. However, with only 27 minutes to close, the stock has already gapped up 10.5% on strong earnings news and sits near the upper portion of its range; a short risks a late-day squeeze on positive sentiment, while a long faces the 9-EMA as immediate resistance and the risk of end-of-day profit-taking. The risk/reward in either direction is insufficient to justify a position this close to forced liquidation.
